title: Release
description: A scheduled content change set (RFC-0008): node versions pinned by id, rev and content hash, applied on top of whatever is live at the release's time. A single scheduled publish is a one-item release. Each item records the version that was live when the release was pinned (`base`); if a pinned node or its live base changed before the release runs, the release is held as a conflict instead of overwriting anything. A person's approval is bound to `hash` (`rl1:`), which digests the items only, so a person may move an approved release without re-approving it while an agent's move or any content change voids the approval. Releases live in D1 next to the graph; they are not graph nodes, never enter a snapshot and are not part of site bundles.

title.description: Optional name shown in Studio ("Election night"). A one-item release without a title is shown under its entry's or page's title.

items.description: The pinned changes, at most one per node. A release never contains the site node: site settings, domains and structure are published the ordinary way.

ReleaseId.description: A release id: `rel_` and 6 to 32 letters or digits.

ReleaseHash.description: `rl1:` and the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the release's canonical item lines (site id, then one line per item sorted by node id: kind, node id, target and base versions). The prefix keeps it apart from the graph state hash and from comment bindings (`cm1:`); approvals store it as their state.

ReleaseState.description: Lifecycle. `draft`: proposed or being assembled, nothing locked. `awaiting_approval`: waiting for a person; its nodes are locked. `scheduled`: approved (or allowed by `auto` mode) and locked until it runs. `running`: claimed by the scheduler. `published`: applied; `outcome` names the snapshot. `conflict`: a pinned node or its live base changed; held, nothing published. `missed`: the scheduler reached it more than an hour late; nothing published. `expired`: no valid approval at its time. `failed`: refused at run time (e.g. a dependency is missing). `canceled`: withdrawn.

ReleaseNodeKind.description: Kinds of graph node a release may carry. The site node is never one of them.

ReleaseNodeVersion.description: One version of a node: its revision and the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, whose body the blob store keeps under `nodes/<hash>.json`.

oneOf.title: ReleaseSetItem
oneOf.description: Make `target` the live version of the node. `base` is the version that was live when the item was pinned; absent when the node was not live (a new entry or page).

oneOf.title: ReleaseRemoveItem
oneOf.description: Take the node out of the live snapshot. `base` is the live version that is removed.

ReleaseWhen.description: When the release runs, discriminated by `kind`. Absent while a draft has no time yet.

oneOf.title: ReleaseAt
oneOf.description: At an instant. `at` is what the scheduler compares with the clock; when a person entered a wall-clock time, `localTime` keeps it and `at` is recomputed from it and `timeZone` before the release runs, never earlier than the wall-clock time.

oneOf.title: ReleaseOnApproval
oneOf.description: As soon as it is approved (a gate-only change such as setting an expiry on live content, or "publish when approved").

ReleasePerson.description: A staff person (`user_…`). Agents never appear here.

ReleaseApproval.description: Why the release may run, discriminated by `kind`.

oneOf.title: ReleasePersonApproval
oneOf.description: A person approved these items (bound to `hash`) for `executeAt`, either by deciding an agent's request (`approvalId`) or by scheduling it themselves. The person's rights are checked again when the release runs.

oneOf.title: ReleaseAutoApproval
oneOf.description: An agent key in `auto` mode scheduled a low-risk release without a person (ADR-0015). Valid only while the release runs before `windowEnds`: the end of the key's elevation, or 24 hours after scheduling, whichever comes first.

ReleaseConflict.description: A node whose live version was not the pinned base when the release ran. `expected` absent: the node was not expected to be live; `found` absent: it was not live.

ReleaseOutcome.description: What happened when the release was due, discriminated by `kind` (it matches the terminal `state`).

oneOf.title: ReleasePublishedOutcome
oneOf.description: Applied: `snapshotId` is the new live snapshot (reason `scheduled`), composed from `baseSnapshotId` and the items. `purge` says how the edge cache followed.

oneOf.title: ReleaseConflictOutcome
oneOf.description: Held: these nodes changed since the release was pinned. Nothing was published.

oneOf.title: ReleaseFailedOutcome
oneOf.description: Refused at run time; nothing was published.

oneOf.title: ReleaseMissedOutcome
oneOf.description: The scheduler reached the release more than an hour after its time; nothing was published. A person may publish it now.

oneOf.title: ReleaseExpiredOutcome
oneOf.description: No valid approval when the release was due: never approved, the approver can no longer publish it, the agent's `auto` window ended, or its creator left.

oneOf.title: ReleaseCanceledOutcome
oneOf.description: Withdrawn by a person or an agent; its nodes are unlocked.
